_doc: Share counts for NSE SME listings that have NO shareholding-pattern filing on NSE's SME board yet (listed after the last half-year end). Derived from screener.in's displayed Market Cap / Current Price (both rounded to ~3 significant figures -> count accurate to ~0.5%), company identity checked by name + NSE symbol on the page. FALLBACK ONLY: build_compressed.py and build_stock_slices.py read it only when scripts/shares_outstanding.json has no count for the symbol, so the first real filing supersedes it automatically. DATA_RUNBOOK §145. Delete an entry once shares_outstanding.json carries the symbol.
